prompt: Priya placed three (glass / juice) on the tray for her tired guests.
explanation_ru: Существительное juice неисчисляемое, поэтому для счёта используется исчисляемое слово glass во множественном числе с предлогом of: three glasses of juice.

prompt: Most managers do not expect (much / many) previous (experience) from a junior assistant, provided the person listens carefully during training.
explanation_ru: В значении «опыт работы» слово experience неисчисляемое: оно не принимает окончание -s и в отрицании сочетается с much, а не many.

prompt: Have you checked the kitchen? — Yes, the cooking equipment (to be) clean.
explanation_ru: Слово equipment неисчисляемое, поэтому в настоящем времени с ним употребляется глагол в единственном числе is.

prompt: Sorry to text you during lunch, but I have a (bit / bad news) about our Friday train.
explanation_ru: Существительное news неисчисляемое и не используется напрямую с артиклем a; чтобы выделить одну новость, нужна конструкция a bit of bad news.

prompt: We shared two (bowl / soup) after walking home in the rain.
explanation_ru: Soup — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому порции считают через ёмкость во множественном числе с предлогом of: two bowls of soup.

prompt: Cycling through Norwich feels safer when there are (fewer / less) delivery vans and (fewer / less) heavy traffic on the bridge.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе (delivery vans) используется fewer, а с неисчисляемым (traffic) — less.

prompt: How many (piece / luggage) can I take on the night coach?
explanation_ru: После how many требуется исчисляемая форма, а слово luggage неисчисляемое, поэтому количество багажа считают через pieces of luggage.

prompt: Could I offer you (a few / a little) (advice) before you sign that flat contract?
explanation_ru: Существительное advice в английском неисчисляемое, поэтому оно не имеет формы множественного числа и сочетается с a little, а не a few.

prompt: Several doctors questioned the new diet because it relied on only one small (piece / research) from a single village clinic.
explanation_ru: Слово research неисчисляемое и не употребляется с числительным one напрямую; для обозначения одного исследования используется конструкция piece of research.

prompt: Neither teacher thought we would need extra (chair) and new sound (equipment) until forty parents booked seats for the autumn concert.
explanation_ru: Chair — исчисляемое существительное и здесь стоит во множественном числе без артикля (extra chairs), а equipment неисчисляемое и всегда сохраняет форму без -s.

prompt: Owen sat at the kitchen table with his maths folder. He did not have (much / many) free time before dinner. He still had two short (exercise) and a lot of maths (homework) to finish. Half an hour later his little sister hid his ruler.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым free time в отрицании нужен определитель much, исчисляемое exercise после числительного two принимает форму exercises, а homework всегда неисчисляемое.

prompt: My brother Marek hates crowded shops, so he buys birthday gifts online. Last week he sent me two warm (item / clothing) in a bright green box. He did not have (some / any) wrapping paper at home, so he used old maps instead. Sadly, the spare (money) from my voucher was not enough to buy matching gloves.
explanation_ru: Неисчисляемое clothing считают с помощью items of clothing, в отрицательном предложении перед wrapping paper ставится any, а существительное money всегда остаётся в единственном числе.

prompt: Guess what! My cousin Tunde is calling from the train with three exciting (bit / news) about his new job. The best news (to be) that he starts in Lisbon on Monday. He already promised to mail us four (postcard) from the harbour.
explanation_ru: Неисчисляемое news считают через bits of news и согласуют с глаголом единственного числа is, а исчисляемое postcard после four стоит во множественном числе.

prompt: Moving into a third-floor flat without a lift tested our patience. We ordered two heavy (item / furniture) for the hall, even though the old wooden (furniture) already filled half the room. Did we check whether there was (some / any) room near the stairs before paying? Of course not, so we ended up eating cold sandwiches on the floorboards.
explanation_ru: Furniture — неисчисляемое существительное: отдельные предметы называют через items of furniture, само слово не принимает -s, а в вопросе с неисчисляемым room используется any.

prompt: Wait a minute, my phone battery is dead! Could you pass me a (sheet / paper) so I can write down the plumber's number? I also need to find some (information) about the bus times. Thanks, I will run to the stop right away.
explanation_ru: Бумага как материал неисчисляема, поэтому один лист обозначается сочетанием a sheet of paper, а слово information не образует форму множественного числа.

prompt: The seaside hotel looked charming in the online brochure. Inside, our bedroom had two squeaky (bed), while the breakfast counter gave each guest only one thin (slice / toast). When we asked at reception, the staff had no (knowledge) of any local taxi firms. We carried our bags to the main road and caught a coach back to Cardiff.
explanation_ru: Исчисляемое bed после числительного two получает окончание -s, тосты считают через slice of toast, а knowledge остаётся неисчисляемым без множественного числа.

prompt: Would you like ___ honey in your herbal tea, Farida?
explanation_ru: В вежливом предложении с неисчисляемым существительным honey используется some; варианты a, many и a few подходят только к исчисляемым существительным.

prompt: Nobody could hear the street musician because there was ___ near the market square.
explanation_ru: Слово noise в значении «шум» неисчисляемое, поэтому с ним используется too much без окончания -s; частая ошибка — ставить many или noises.

prompt: Before flying to Osaka, Declan asked the travel agent for ___ about train passes.
explanation_ru: Information — неисчисляемое существительное: с ним нельзя использовать артикль a, определители many/a few или окончание -s, поэтому верен вариант some useful information.

prompt: Could we stop at the bakery for ___ before dinner?
explanation_ru: Bread в английском неисчисляемое, поэтому нельзя сказать a bread, two breads или many bread; целую буханку называют a loaf of bread.

prompt: Sofia has made a lot of progress in swimming this term, and her coach is proud.
answer: Sofia has made a lot of progress in swimming this term, and her coach is proud.
accepted_answers: Sofia has made a lot of progress in swimming this term, and her coach is proud.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: существительное progress неисчисляемое, поэтому оно употребляется без окончания -s вместе с выражением a lot of.

prompt: Our heavy luggage are already packed inside the boot of the red taxi.
answer: Our heavy luggage is already packed inside the boot of the red taxi.
accepted_answers: Our heavy luggage is already packed inside the boot of the red taxi.
explanation_ru: Существительное luggage неисчисляемое и требует глагола в единственном числе (is, а не are), даже если речь идёт о нескольких чемоданах.

prompt: Detectives spent two hours searching the garden behind the old cinema and finally discovered a new evidence near the fence.
answer: Detectives spent two hours searching the garden behind the old cinema and finally discovered a new piece of evidence near the fence.
accepted_answers: Detectives spent two hours searching the garden behind the old cinema and finally discovered a new piece of evidence near the fence.
Detectives spent two hours searching the garden behind the old cinema and finally discovered new evidence near the fence.
Detectives spent two hours searching the garden behind the old cinema and finally discovered some new evidence near the fence.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить артикль a перед неисчисляемым существительным evidence; нужно использовать a new piece of evidence либо (some) new evidence.

prompt: Keiko played one short tune by Mozart and two folk melodies at the school concert. Which sentence reports this correctly?
options: She performed three musics at the school concert.
She performed three pieces of music at the school concert.
She performed a few music at the school concert.
She performed many music at the school concert.
explanation_ru: Слово music неисчисляемое, поэтому отдельные музыкальные произведения считают с помощью конструкции pieces of music.

prompt: Dmitry and Nadia had to move four microphones, two speakers, and three canvas bags into their van before the rain started. Which sentence describes this accurately?
options: They loaded three bags and all the sound equipments into the van before it rained.
They loaded three bags and many sound equipment into the van before it rained.
They loaded three bags and a few sound equipment into the van before it rained.
They loaded three bags and all the sound equipment into the van before it rained.
explanation_ru: Bags — исчисляемое существительное, а equipment — неисчисляемое: оно не принимает окончание -s и не сочетается с many или a few.

prompt: Our history teacher gave us no extra homework before the trip, although she assigned two long essays for the weekend. → Our history teacher did not give us …
answer: Our history teacher did not give us any extra homework before the trip, although she assigned two long essays for the weekend.
accepted_answers: Our history teacher did not give us any extra homework before the trip, although she assigned two long essays for the weekend.
Our history teacher didn't give us any extra homework before the trip, although she assigned two long essays for the weekend.
explanation_ru: При замене отрицания с no на глагольное отрицание did not перед неисчисляемым homework ставится any, а само слово homework остаётся без окончания -s.
